summary: 2026/27 home kit by JAKO (the club's technical partner): Kazanorgsintez general sponsor on the front and back, Nizhnekamskneftekhim (SIBUR group) on the upper front, FONBET on the chest, back, sleeve and shorts, Ak Bars Bank wordmark on the front and its logo patch on the sleeve — all documented in the official club store's product photos. The shirt also carries a Republic of Tatarstan coat-of-arms roundel and a Gabdulla Tukay 140th-anniversary chevron (design/commemorative elements, not paying sponsors on the partners list). Not marked complete: the store photos do not show the back of the shorts or socks.
